evidence.title: Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training

summary: Researchers surveyed and tested university students who used ChatGPT alongside a structured critical‑thinking curriculum, finding measurable improvements in answer quality and broader analytical abilities. The results suggest that AI tools, when paired with explicit reasoning instruction, can enhance learning outcomes beyond traditional methods.
title: Study Finds ChatGPT Combined with Critical‑Thinking Training Boosts Student Performance and Reasoning Skills
